# Radoslav Radev Recommends Having a Strategy and Structure for Planche Training, Training Three Times Per Week Consistently

Radoslav Radev recommends having a strategy and structure for planche training, including knowing how many seconds to hold each progression, when to go to the next progression, and training three times per week consistently while tracking results. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:03]

## Details

- The third thing is really really important: to have strategy and structure, because if you do not have a strategy, a lot of people lose a lot of time going too early on the next progression. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:03]
- If you do not have the right technique and activation and go to the next progression too early, you lose protraction and build wrong habits with bad form. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 04:17]
- The strategy and structure for the week helps you to be consistent, because a lot of people want to achieve the planche but they do not have any strategy. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 06:07]
- You can train three times per week but consistent, and to track your results and to think when and how is the best time to go on the next progression. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 06:45]
- A lot of people think they have slow progress, but actually the progress is not slow, they are staying too much on the current progression and they are ready for the next one but they do not know about it. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 07:02]
- If you have the right preparation with the good amount of basics pull-ups dips and push-ups, the right understanding about the right technique, and if you have plan and strategy, you know what to do and you will save a lot of time. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 07:15]

## Why This Matters

He says that nobody told him and he wasted a lot of time learning the planche randomly without knowing if he was progressing well. [src: vid-aXwZ_WI1vSw @ 07:34]
